entities.name: King Dongmyeong of Goguryeo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dongmyeong of Goguryeo, personal name Ko Chumong, was the founding monarch of the kingdom of Goguryeo, and was worshipped as a god-king by the people of Goguryeo and Goryeo. King Dongmyeong was also an important figure for the kingdom of Baekje, as the father of its founding monarch, King Onjo.
